cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've done a night shift. Sit on the sofa, feet up; I have lunch and the house under control.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is there a bucket by the armchair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A little drip. Leave the bucket where it is; catching water properly saves moving it twice. Your tray is here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take lunch upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Rest here first. I'll bring the duvet down; bedding goes back only when everything is dry. Please let me finish one job without you starting another shift.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 control of house care, A3 bucket-placement correction and A5 bedding order make A expert management the means of sparing a tired partner the leak problem.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 bucket question causes minimisation and tray diversion; B4 upstairs plan causes A5 duvet relocation and drying rule.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices the household problem and B4 wants immediate sleep; A adapts care to keep B out of the repair.

heightening.evidence: A5 absorbs the bedding task and gently resists B involvement after B4 threatens to see upstairs.

specificity.evidence: A1 night shift, B2 bucket and A5 dry-before-bedding rule make the concealed practical problem intelligible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 another-shift phrase directly asks the tired partner not to take on more work, rather than merely describing kindness.
